reported.what: postprandial glucose, insulin, C-peptide and glucagon concentrations by minute, by eater group, after the 402 g mixed meal (77 g carbohydrate, 15 g fat, 25 g protein), mean or geometric mean with 95% CI

location.quote: Slower-eaters exhibited 20.21% and 55.27% higher early (0–30 min) and total (0–180 min) iAUC glucose values, respectively

detail: Every number the paper prints for glucose, insulin, C-peptide and glucagon is reported for the two groups formed by a median split of the eating rate measured during the test meal, with no pooled cohort value printed (the time courses are in figures only), and neither group is a healthy reference, so no arm can be written without asking the model for two different numbers from the same 33 people.
